lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Long 90 deg fold between base plate A (patch 1) and flange B (patch 3). In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the outer-skin apex: the lowest outer point is within 0.01-0.1 mm of the line along the bisector. Scanning along the fold, the outer apex exists from t=0 to about 22.5 mm, and the line runs t=0 to 22.36. At t<0 there is the notch, so there is no fold there. The line is parallel and covers essentially the whole fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Short 90 deg fold between A (patch 1) and the slanted corner tab C (patch 5). Sections at 25/50/75% show the label on the outer apex, within 0.02-0.08 mm. Along the line the apex is present from about t=0.25 to 9.2 mm, and the line runs 0 to 8.98. It ends at the notch on one side and at the tab edge on the other, so it covers about the whole fold.
